title: विंशतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: After Shalva's death the Kaurava army is routed, and Kritavarman and Satyaki fight, with Kritavarman's horses and charioteer slain. Kritavarman takes another chariot and fights on until the Pandava forces drive him back.
summary.kn: ಶಾಲ್ವ ಹತನಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೌರವ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಓಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಕೃತವರ್ಮ-ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಕೃತವರ್ಮನ ಕುದುರೆ, ಸಾರಥಿ ಹತರಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕೃತವರ್ಮ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ರಥ ಏರಿ ಪಾಂಡವ ಪಡೆಗಳು ಅವನನ್ನು ಹಿಂದಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳುವವರೆಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शाल्व के मरने पर कौरव सेना भाग निकलती है, और कृतवर्मा-सात्यकि लड़ते हैं, कृतवर्मा के घोड़े और सारथी मारे जाते हैं। कृतवर्मा दूसरा रथ लेकर तब तक लड़ता है जब तक पाण्डव सेना उसे पीछे नहीं हटा देती।
summary.te: శాల్వుడు చనిపోయాక కౌరవసేన పారిపోతుంది; కృతవర్మ, సాత్యకి పోరాడతారు, కృతవర్మ గుర్రాలు, సారథి చంపబడతారు. కృతవర్మ మరో రథం ఎక్కి పాండవ బలగాలు అతన్ని వెనక్కి తరిమే వరకు పోరాడతాడు.
summary.ta: சால்வன் இறந்ததும் கௌரவப் படை ஓட, கிருதவர்மனும் சாத்யகியும் போரிட, கிருதவர்மனின் குதிரைகளும் தேரோட்டியும் கொல்லப்படுகின்றனர். கிருதவர்மன் வேறு தேரில் ஏறிப் பாண்டவப் படைகள் அவனைப் பின்தள்ளும் வரை போரிடுகிறான்.
summary.ml: ശാല്വന്റെ മരണശേഷം കൗരവസേന തോൽക്കുന്നു; കൃതവർമ്മാവും സാത്യകിയും പൊരുതുന്നു, കൃതവർമ്മാവിന്റെ കുതിരകളും സാരഥിയും കൊല്ലപ്പെടുന്നു. അദ്ദേഹം മറ്റൊരു രഥമെടുത്ത് പാണ്ഡവസേന പിന്നോട്ടോടിക്കുന്നതുവരെ പൊരുതുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.20; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे शाल्वे समितिशोभने ।
तवाभज्यद्बलं वेगाद्वातेनेव महाद्रुमः ॥

meaning.en: When the brave Shalva, the ornament of the assembly of warriors, was slain, your army broke swiftly, as a great tree is torn by the wind.

verses.text:
तत्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा कृतवर्मा महारथः ।
दधार समरे शूरः शत्रुसैन्यं महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that army shattered, the mighty great chariot-fighter Kritavarman, a hero, held back the enemy host in the battle.

verses.text:
संनिवृत्तास्तु ते शूरा दृष्ट्वा सात्वतमाहवे ।
शैलोपमं स्थितं राजन्कीर्यमाणं शरैर्युधि ॥

meaning.en: Those heroes turned back when they saw the Satvata Kritavarman standing like a mountain in the battle while arrows were showered on him.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह ।
निवृत्तानां महाराज मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the fight between the Kauravas and the Pandavas resumed, O great king, among men who had turned back with death as their only way of return.

verses.text:
तत्राश्चर्यमभूद्युद्धं सात्वतस्य परैः सह ।
यदेको वारयामास पाण्डुसेनां दुरासदाम् ॥

meaning.en: It was a marvelous fight between the Satvata and his enemies, for he alone held back the unassailable Pandava army.

verses.text:
तेषामन्योन्यसुहृदां कृते कर्मणि दुष्करे ।
सिंहनादः प्रहृष्टानां दिवःस्पृक्सुमहानभूत् ॥

meaning.en: For that hard deed done for one another as friends, a very great lion-roar, touching the sky, rose from the delighted warriors.

verses.text:
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तान्पाञ्चालान्भरतर्षभ ।
शिनेर्नप्ता महाबाहुरन्वपद्यत सात्यकिः ॥

meaning.en: At that sound the Panchalas were terrified, O bull of the Bharatas, and the mighty-armed Satyaki, grandson of Shini, went after them.

verses.text:
स समासाद्य राजानं क्षेमधूर्तिं महाबलम् ।
सप्तभिर्निशितैर्बाणैरनयद्यमसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the powerful king Kshemadhurti, he sent him to the abode of Yama with seven sharp arrows.

verses.text:
तमायान्तं महाबाहुं प्रवपन्तं शिताञ्शरान् ।
जवेनाभ्यपतद्धीमान्हार्दिक्यः शिनिपुंगवम् ॥

meaning.en: As the mighty-armed Satyaki came on, showering sharp arrows, the wise son of Hridika, Kritavarman, rushed swiftly against that bull of the Shinis.

verses.text:
तौ सिंहाविव नर्दन्तौ धन्विनौ रथिनां वरौ ।
अन्योन्यमभ्यधावेतां शस्त्रप्रवरधारिणौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two archers, best of chariot-warriors, roaring like lions, bearing the finest weapons, charged at each other.

verses.text:
पाण्डवाः सह पाञ्चालैर्योधाश्चान्ये नृपोत्तमाः ।
प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas with the Panchalas, and other excellent kings, became mere spectators of those two lions among men.

verses.text:
नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथौ ।
अभिजघ्नतुरन्योन्यं प्रहृष्टाविव कुञ्जरौ ॥

meaning.en: The two great chariot-fighters, of the Vrishni and Andhaka lines, struck each other with iron arrows and calf-tooth shafts, like two delighted elephants.

verses.text:
चरन्तौ विविधान्मार्गान्हार्दिक्यशिनिपुंगवौ ।
मुहुरन्तर्दधाते तौ बाणवृष्ट्या परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: The son of Hridika and the bull of the Shinis, moving in many patterns, repeatedly hid each other under showers of arrows.

verses.text:
चापवेगबलोद्धूतान्मार्गणान्वृष्णिसिंहयोः ।
आकाशे समपश्याम पतंगानिव शीघ्रगान् ॥

meaning.en: In the sky we saw the arrows loosed by those two Vrishni lions, driven by the force of their bows, like swift-flying birds.

verses.text:
तमेकं सत्यकर्माणमासाद्य हृदिकात्मजः ।
अविध्यन्निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् ॥

meaning.en: The son of Hridika, attacking the one Satyaki, true in his deeds, pierced his four horses with four sharp arrows.

verses.text:
स दीर्घबाहुः संक्रुद्धस्तोत्त्रार्दित इव द्विपः ।
अष्टाभिः कृतवर्माणमविध्यत्परमेषुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, long-armed and enraged like an elephant pricked by the goad, pierced Kritavarman with eight excellent arrows.

verses.text:
ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः कृतवर्मा शिलाशितैः ।
सात्यकिं त्रिभिराहत्य धनुरेकेन चिच्छिदे ॥

meaning.en: Then Kritavarman, with arrows whetted on stone and loosed with the bow fully drawn, struck Satyaki with three and cut his bow in two with one.

verses.text:
निकृत्तं तद्धनुःश्रेष्ठमपास्य शिनिपुंगवः ।
अन्यदादत्त वेगेन शैनेयः सशरं धनुः ॥

meaning.en: The bull of the Shinis threw aside that fine bow, cut down, and quickly took up another bow and arrow, the descendant of Shini.

verses.text:
तदादाय धनुःश्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठः सर्वधन्विनाम् ।
आरोप्य च महावीर्यो महाबुद्धिर्महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Taking that excellent bow, Satyaki, the best of all archers, of great valor, great intelligence and great strength, strung it.

verses.text:
अमृष्यमाणो धनुषश्छेदनं कृतवर्मणा ।
कुपितोऽतिरथः शीघ्रं कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Unable to bear his bow being cut by Kritavarman, the enraged great chariot-fighter quickly went at Kritavarman.

verses.text:
ततः सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्दशभिः शिनिपुंगवः ।
जघान सूतमश्वांश्च ध्वजं च कृतवर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: Then the bull of the Shinis killed Kritavarman's charioteer, horses and banner with ten very sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ततो राजन्महेष्वासः कृतवर्मा महारथः ।
हताश्वसूतं संप्रेक्ष्य रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, the great archer and great chariot-fighter Kritavarman saw his gold-adorned chariot with its horses and charioteer slain.

verses.text:
रोषेण महताविष्टः शूलमुद्यम्य मारिष ।
चिक्षेप भुजवेगेन जिघांसुः शिनिपुंगवम् ॥

meaning.en: Seized with great anger, O revered one, he raised a spear and hurled it with the force of his arm, wishing to kill the bull of the Shinis.

verses.text:
तच्छूलं सात्वतो ह्याजौ निर्भिद्य निशितैः शरैः ।
चूर्णितं पातयामास मोहयन्निव माधवम् ।
ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन हृद्येनं समताडयत् ॥

meaning.en: The Satvata pierced that spear in the battle with sharp arrows and brought it down in pieces, as though baffling Madhava's kinsman; then he struck Kritavarman in the chest with another broad-headed arrow.

verses.text:
स युद्धे युयुधानेन हताश्वो हतसारथिः ।
कृतवर्मा कृतास्त्रेण धरणीमन्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: Thus in the battle Kritavarman, with horses and charioteer slain by the skilled Yuyudhana, went on foot to the ground.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्सात्यकिना वीरे द्वैरथे विरथीकृते ।
समपद्यत सर्वेषां सैन्यानां सुमहद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: When the hero Kritavarman was left chariotless by Satyaki in that chariot duel, a very great fear arose in all the armies.

verses.text:
पुत्रस्य तव चात्यर्थं विषादः समपद्यत ।
हतसूते हताश्वे च विरथे कृतवर्मणि ॥

meaning.en: And your son was deeply dejected when Kritavarman was left with charioteer and horses slain and without a chariot.

verses.text:
हताश्वं च समालक्ष्य हतसूतमरिंदमम् ।
अभ्यधावत्कृपो राजञ्जिघांसुः शिनिपुंगवम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him with horses and charioteer killed, Kripa, O king, rushed at the bull of the Shinis, wishing to kill him.

verses.text:
तमारोप्य रथोपस्थे मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम् ।
अपोवाह महाबाहुस्तूर्णमायोधनादपि ॥

meaning.en: Placing Kritavarman, subduer of foes, on his chariot platform, the mighty-armed Kripa carried him quickly away from the battlefield, while all the archers looked on.

verses.text:
शैनेयेऽधिष्ठिते राजन्विरथे कृतवर्मणि ।
दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत्पराङ्मुखम् ॥

meaning.en: When Kritavarman was borne off, chariotless, and Satyaki stood victorious, O king, all of Duryodhana's army turned away once more.

verses.text:
तत्परे नावबुध्यन्त सैन्येन रजसावृते ।
तावकाः प्रद्रुता राजन्दुर्योधनमृते नृपम् ॥

meaning.en: Their army shrouded in dust, the enemy did not notice; and your men fled, O king, all but King Duryodhana.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनस्तु संप्रेक्ष्य भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात् ।
जवेनाभ्यपतत्तूर्णं सर्वांश्चैको न्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana, seeing his army broken near him, charged swiftly and, alone, checked them all.

verses.text:
पाण्डूंश्च सर्वान्संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम् ।
शिखण्डिनं द्रौपदेयान्पाञ्चालानां च ये गणाः ॥

meaning.en: Enraged, he held back all the Pandavas with sharp weapons, calmly, he who was hard to assail, and also Dhrishtadyumna, son of Prishata, Shikhandi, the sons of Draupadi and the bands of the Panchalas,

verses.text:
केकयान्सोमकांश्चैव पाञ्चालांश्चैव मारिष ।
असंभ्रमं दुराधर्षः शितैरस्त्रैरवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: and the Kekayas, the Somakas and the Panchalas, O revered one.

verses.text:
अतिष्ठदाहवे यत्तः पुत्रस्तव महाबलः ।
यथा यज्ञे महानग्निर्मन्त्रपूतः प्रकाशयन् ॥

meaning.en: Your mighty son stood intent in the battle like a great sacrificial fire sanctified by mantras and blazing at the rite.

verses.text:
तं परे नाभ्यवर्तन्त मर्त्या मृत्युमिवाहवे ।
अथान्यं रथमास्थाय हार्दिक्यः समपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: The enemy did not approach him, as mortals do not approach Death in battle. Then Kritavarman, son of Hridika, took another chariot and rejoined the fight.
